pages.name: Bishop's Opening: Paulsen Defence
pages.notes: Plan 2 had exd5 before Black's ...d5. Rewrote it around Bb3 so ...d5 gains no time; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: Bishop's Opening: Paulsen, 4.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote 0-0 and a d2-f1-g3 route with no knight on d2; plan 4 had ...Be6 with the d7-pawn blocking and a b7 bishop behind the c6-pawn; plan 2 had ...d6 before ...d5. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: Bishop's Opening: Ponziani Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 listed Black's Nxe4 as a White move; plan 1 spoke of open files that don't exist yet. Rewrote plans 1 and 2 (3...exd4 4.Nf3 Nxe4 5.Qxd4, then Nc3, Bg5, long castling); British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Bishop's Opening: Urusov Gambit, Larsen Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had h4-h5 with the queen on h4 and sacrifices on e6; plan 2 a pin that isn't one. Rewrote plans 1-2 (Bd3, Bxf6 and Qxh7 mate; ...dxc4 drops the queen to the d1-rook, first wording rejected by the reviewer and revised); British spelling in overview and plan 3.

pages.name: Vienna Gambit, with Max Lange Defense: Hamppe-Muzio Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Rae1 with the c1-bishop and queen in the way and the queen hitting f7 through the f4-pawn (reviewer). Rewrote around Qxf3 hitting f4, the c4-bishop on f7, d4 and Bxf4.

pages.name: Vienna Gambit, with Max Lange Defense: Quelle Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 castled kingside while the c5-bishop covers g1, and pushed d4 into Bc5 and Nc6 (reviewer); plan 4 had Bxd6 before exd6 and White's f4-push after fxe5. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Vienna Gambit, with Max Lange Defense: Steinitz Gambit, Paulsen Defense
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Kf2 with the h4-queen covering f2, and its rewrite mentioned a check no longer on the board (reviewer). Rewrote; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: Vienna Gambit, with Max Lange Defense: Steinitz Gambit, Sörensen Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Kg2 with the king on e2. Rewrote it (Nf3 hitting the queen, g3 against f4); British spelling in overview and plan 3.

pages.name: Vienna Game
pages.notes: Plan 4 named an early f4 in a Black plan. Reworded; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Vienna Game: Max Lange Defense
pages.notes: Plan 4 named an early f4 in a Black plan. Reworded; British spelling in overview and plan 3.
